name: Non-acquired Combined Pituitary Hormone Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Combined Pituitary Hormone Deficiency Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Deficiency of two or more anterior pituitary hormones confirmed by biochemical testing
MRI evidence of pituitary hypoplasia or structural abnormalities of the hypothalamic-pituitary axis
Presence of clinical signs consistent with hormone deficiencies such as growth retardation, hypoglycemia, or hypothyroidism
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with pituitary development (e.g., PROP1, POU1F1)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Biochemical confirmation of deficiency in two or more anterior pituitary hormones plus MRI evidence of pituitary abnormalities and consistent clinical features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing can support diagnosis but is not mandatory.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe growth hormone deficiency with growth retardation
searchTerms: poor growth due to hormone deficiency

pathognomonic.symptomName: Central hypothyroidism with low free T4 and inappropriately normal or low TSH
searchTerms: low thyroid hormone with normal TSH

pathognomonic.symptomName: Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) deficiency causing secondary adrenal insufficiency
searchTerms: secondary adrenal failure from low ACTH
pituitary hormone deficiency affecting adrenal glands

common.symptomName: Hypoglycemia due to cortisol and growth hormone deficiencies
searchTerms: low blood sugar from hormone deficiency
hypoglycemia due to low cortisol and growth hormone
low glucose levels from hormone problems

common.symptomName: Delayed or absent puberty from gonadotropin deficiency
searchTerms: late or no puberty due to hormone deficiency
delayed sexual development from low gonadotropins
absent puberty caused by pituitary hormone lack

common.symptomName: Fatigue and weakness related to hypothyroidism and adrenal insufficiency
searchTerms: tiredness and weakness from low thyroid and adrenal hormones
fatigue related to hypothyroidism and adrenal failure

common.symptomName: Micropenis or cryptorchidism in affected male infants

searchTerms: low blood pressure from adrenal insufficiency

occasional.notes: Though hepatic is not in the valid set, this can be noted as occasional but bodySystem must be chosen from valid set; assign 'constitutional' instead

occasional.symptomName: Poor feeding and failure to thrive in infancy
searchTerms: failure to gain weight as infant

occasional.symptomName: Headache related to pituitary mass effect
searchTerms: head pain due to pituitary swelling

occasional.symptomName: Visual field defects due to pituitary stalk or hypothalamic involvement
searchTerms: partial vision loss due to brain lesion
seizures caused by low blood sugar

rare.symptomName: Hyponatremia due to secondary adrenal insufficiency
searchTerms: low blood sodium from adrenal insufficiency

rare.symptomName: Psychiatric manifestations such as depression or cognitive impairment
searchTerms: mental health issues like low mood or thinking difficulties

laboratory: Low serum levels of two or more anterior pituitary hormones (GH, TSH, ACTH, LH, FSH, prolactin)
Low target gland hormones (e.g., cortisol, free T4, sex steroids)
imaging: MRI showing hypoplastic or absent anterior pituitary gland
genetic: Pathogenic variants in PROP1, POU1F1, HESX1, LHX3, LHX4, or SOX3 genes
other: Family history of pituitary hormone deficiencies

distinguishingFeatures: History of trauma, tumor, infection, or radiation
Later onset after infancy or childhood
MRI evidence of acquired pituitary damage
Deficiency limited to growth hormone only
Normal levels of other pituitary hormones
No structural pituitary abnormalities on imaging

redFlags: Failure to thrive with multiple hormone deficiencies
Signs of adrenal crisis such as hypotension and hyponatremia
